<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Mario Dad Joke Quiz</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=Nunito:wght@400;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --mario-red:#e52521;--mario-blue:#0073ce;--mario-yellow:#fbd000;
  --mario-green:#43a047;--mario-dark:#1a0a00;--mario-sky:#5c94fc;
  --mario-coin:#ffd700;--mario-pink:#ff6b9d;--mario-purple:#9b59b6;
}
body{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#2b2b2b;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;padding:20px;}
#quiz-wrap{min-height:580px;width:100%;max-width:540px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;transition:background 0.8s;}
#quiz-wrap.mode-dad{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--mario-sky) 0%,#87ceeb 58%,var(--mario-green) 58%,#388e3c 100%);}
#quiz-wrap.mode-flirt{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffb3cc 0%,#ffd6e8 55%,#ff6b9d 55%,#e91e7a 100%);}
.clouds{position:absolute;top:10px;width:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.cloud{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;opacity:0.9}
.ground-row{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:48px;z-index:1;transition:background 0.8s;}
.mode-dad .ground-row{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mario-green) 0 40px,#388e3c 40px 80px);}
.mode-flirt .ground-row{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mario-pink) 0 40px,#e91e7a 40px 80px);}
.main-area{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:22px 18px 60px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.score-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 4px}
.score-pill{background:var(--mario-dark);color:var(--mario-yellow);border:3px solid var(--mario-yellow);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 14px;font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.coin-icon{display:inline-block;width:13px;height:13px;background:var(--mario-coin);border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #c8a200}
.card{background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--mario-dark);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--mario-dark);width:100%;padding:20px 20px 18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:7px;}
.mode-dad .card::before{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mario-red) 0 18px,var(--mario-dark) 18px 20px);}
.mode-flirt .card::before{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mario-pink) 0 18px,var(--mario-purple) 18px 20px);}
.q-number{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:9px;margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:12px;letter-spacing:1px}
.mode-dad .q-number{color:var(--mario-red);}
.mode-flirt .q-number{color:var(--mario-pink);}
.sentence-wrap{font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:#000;line-height:2;margin-bottom:16px;word-break:break-word}
.blank-input{display:inline-block;min-width:90px;padding:2px 8px;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#000;border:none;border-bottom:3px solid var(--mario-dark);background:transparent;outline:none;text-align:center;vertical-align:baseline;transition:border-color 0.15s;}
.blank-input:focus{border-color:var(--mario-blue)}
.blank-input.correct-input{border-color:var(--mario-green);color:var(--mario-green)}
.blank-input.wrong-input{border-color:var(--mario-red);color:var(--mario-red)}
.blank-input:disabled{background:transparent}
.submit-btn{color:#fff;border:3px solid var(--mario-dark);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 20px;font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--mario-dark);transition:transform 0.1s;display:block;margin-top:14px;}
.mode-dad .submit-btn{background:var(--mario-blue);}
.mode-flirt .submit-btn{background:var(--mario-pink);}
.submit-btn:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--mario-dark)}
.submit-btn:active{transform:translate(2px,2px);box-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--mario-dark)}
.submit-btn:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:default;transform:none;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--mario-dark)}
.feedback{margin-top:12px;padding:10px 13px;border-radius:10px;border:3px solid;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;display:none;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;line-height:1.4}
.feedback.show{display:flex}
.feedback.ok{background:#e0f7e0;border-color:var(--mario-green);color:#000}
.feedback.fail{background:#fde;border-color:var(--mario-red);color:#000}
.feedback.ok-flirt{background:#ffe0ee;border-color:var(--mario-pink);color:#000}
.cat-img{width:54px;height:54px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;border:2px solid var(--mario-dark);flex-shrink:0}
.reveal-ans{font-size:12px;color:#555;font-weight:700;margin-top:5px}
.reveal-ans b{color:var(--mario-green)}
.next-btn{margin-top:12px;color:#fff;border:3px solid var(--mario-dark);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 22px;font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--mario-dark);display:none;transition:transform 0.1s}
.mode-dad .next-btn{background:var(--mario-red);}
.mode-flirt .next-btn{background:var(--mario-purple);}
.next-btn:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--mario-dark)}
.next-btn:active{transform:translate(2px,2px);box-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--mario-dark)}
.next-btn.show{display:block}
.progress-dots{display:flex;gap:8px}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--mario-dark);background:#e0e0e0;transition:background 0.2s}
.dot.done{background:var(--mario-coin)}
.dot.active{animation:pulse 0.8s infinite alternate}
.mode-dad .dot.active{background:var(--mario-red);}
.mode-flirt .dot.active{background:var(--mario-pink);}
@keyframes pulse{to{transform:scale(1.2)}}
.lives{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}

/* Section banner */
.section-banner{background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--mario-dark);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--mario-dark);width:100%;padding:22px 20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:center;}
.section-banner.show{display:flex}
.section-banner::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mario-pink) 0 18px,var(--mario-purple) 18px 20px);}
.banner-emoji{font-size:40px}
.banner-title{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--mario-pink);line-height:1.8}
.banner-sub{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#333;line-height:1.5}
.banner-btn{background:var(--mario-pink);color:#fff;border:3px solid var(--mario-dark);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 22px;font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--mario-dark);transition:transform 0.1s;margin-top:6px;}
.banner-btn:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--mario-dark)}

/* Win screens */
.win-card,.lose-card{background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--mario-dark);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--mario-dark);width:100%;padding:26px 20px 20px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.win-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mario-yellow) 0 18px,var(--mario-dark) 18px 20px)}
.lose-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#888 0 18px,var(--mario-dark) 18px 20px)}
.win-card.show,.lose-card.show{display:flex}
.win-title{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:11px;line-height:1.8}
.win-sub{font-size:13px;color:#000;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6}
.star-rain{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.star{position:absolute;animation:fall linear infinite}
@keyframes fall{0%{transform:translateY(-30px) rotate(0);opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(700px) rotate(360deg);opacity:0}}
.prize-frame{position:relative;width:190px;border:5px solid var(--mario-yellow);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--mario-dark);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.prize-frame img{width:100%;display:block}
.scratch-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,var(--mario-pink) 0 10px,var(--mario-purple) 10px 20px);opacity:0.93;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;transition:opacity 0.6s}
.scratch-overlay.gone{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.scratch-label{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:8px;color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 #000;text-align:center;line-height:1.8;padding:0 8px}
.prize-hint{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:8px;color:var(--mario-dark)}
.retry-btn{background:var(--mario-green);color:#fff;border:3px solid var(--mario-dark);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 20px;font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--mario-dark);transition:transform 0.1s}
.retry-btn:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--mario-dark)}
.win-cat{width:80px;height:80px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;border:3px solid var(--mario-dark);animation:bounce 0.6s infinite alternate}
.lose-cat{width:80px;height:80px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;border:3px solid var(--mario-dark)}
@keyframes bounce{to{transform:translateY(-7px)}}

/* hearts floating */
.heart-rain{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.heart-p{position:absolute;animation:fall linear infinite;font-size:20px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="quiz-wrap" class="mode-dad">
  <div class="clouds">
    <div class="cloud" style="left:4%;top:12px;width:72px;height:28px"></div>
    <div class="cloud" style="left:58%;top:16px;width:92px;height:32px"></div>
    <div class="cloud" style="left:33%;top:7px;width:56px;height:22px"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="main-area">
    <div class="score-bar">
      <div class="score-pill"><span class="coin-icon"></span><span id="score-val">0</span></div>
      <div class="progress-dots" id="dots"></div>
      <div class="lives" id="lives-bar"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Question card -->
    <div class="card" id="q-card">
      <div class="q-number" id="q-num">QUESTION 1 / 4</div>
      <div class="sentence-wrap" id="sentence-wrap"></div>
      <button class="submit-btn" id="submit-btn">CHECK ✓</button>
      <div class="feedback" id="feedback"></div>
      <button class="next-btn" id="next-btn">NEXT &gt;</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Flirt section banner -->
    <div class="section-banner" id="flirt-banner">
      <div class="banner-emoji">💘</div>
      <div class="banner-title">BONUS ROUND!</div>
      <div class="banner-sub">You survived the dad jokes! 🎉<br>Now for a <b>flirty quiz</b>...<br>think you can handle it? 😏</div>
      <button class="banner-btn" onclick="startFlirtRound()">LET'S GO 💕</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Win card -->
    <div class="win-card" id="win-card">
      <div class="star-rain" id="stars"></div>
      <img class="win-cat" id="win-cat-img" src="" alt="happy cat"/>
      <div class="win-title" style="color:var(--mario-pink)">YOU WIN!<br>YOU'RE A FLIRT! 💕</div>
      <div class="win-sub" id="win-msg">Amazing! You got everything right!<br>Here's your prize 🎁</div>
      <div class="prize-frame" id="prize-frame" onclick="revealPrize()">
        <img id="prize-img" src="" alt="Prize"/>
        <div class="scratch-overlay" id="scratch-overlay">
          <div class="scratch-label">💕 TAP TO<br>REVEAL<br>YOUR PRIZE! 💕</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="prize-hint" id="prize-hint">👆 TAP TO SCRATCH!</div>
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="restartGame()">PLAY AGAIN</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Lose card -->
    <div class="lose-card" id="lose-card">
      <img class="lose-cat" id="lose-cat-img" src="" alt="sad cat"/>
      <div class="win-title" style="color:#555">GAME OVER</div>
      <div class="win-sub">You ran out of lives!<br>Score: <span id="lose-score"></span> coin(s)</div>
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="restartGame()">TRY AGAIN</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="ground-row"></div>
</div>
<script>
const HAPPY_CAT = "data:image/gif;base64,";
const SAD_CAT   = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
const PRIZE_IMG = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

document.getElementById('win-cat-img').src  = HAPPY_CAT;
document.getElementById('lose-cat-img').src = SAD_CAT;
document.getElementById('prize-img').src    = PRIZE_IMG;

const dadQuestions = [
  {
    parts: ["Scientists don't trust atoms because they ", " everything."],
    answers: ["make up"],
    win:  "make up EVERYTHING! Atoms — the original liars 🥁",
    lose: "They make up everything!"
  },
  {
    parts: ["The book about anti-gravity is ", " to put down."],
    answers: ["impossible"],
    win:  "IMPOSSIBLE to put down! Classic dad joke 📖",
    lose: "Impossible to put down — just like a good book!"
  },
  {
    parts: ["The scarecrow won an award for being ", " in his field."],
    answers: ["outstanding"],
    win:  "OUTSTANDING in his field! 🌾 Ba dum tss!",
    lose: "Outstanding in his field! That scarecrow earned it."
  },
  {
    parts: ["I know 25 letters of the alphabet. I just don't know ", "."],
    answers: ["y"],
    win:  "You don't know Y! ...Why not? 😂",
    lose: "You don't know Y! The eternal question."
  }
];

const flirtQuestions = [
  {
    parts: ["Are you a magician? Because whenever I look at you, everyone else ", "."],
    answers: ["disappears"],
    win:  "DISAPPEARS ✨ Smooth. Very smooth. 😏",
    lose: "Everyone else DISAPPEARS! Works every time... supposedly."
  },
  {
    parts: ["Do you have a map? I keep getting ", " in your eyes."],
    answers: ["lost"],
    win:  "LOST in your eyes 👀 Ok that one actually landed!",
    lose: "Getting LOST in your eyes! Classic opener 💫"
  },
  {
    parts: ["Are you WiFi? Because I'm feeling a ", " right here."],
    answers: ["connection"],
    win:  "A CONNECTION! Strong signal detected 📶💕",
    lose: "Feeling a CONNECTION! That's the one 💘"
  },
  {
    parts: ["Do you believe in love at first sight, or should I walk by ", "?"],
    answers: ["again"],
    win:  "Walk by AGAIN! 😂 Bold move, 10/10 would try.",
    lose: "Walk by AGAIN! Never fails... or does it? 😅"
  }
];

let current = 0;
let score = 0;
let lives = 3;
let answered = false;
let phase = 'dad'; // 'dad' or 'flirt'
let activeQuestions = dadQuestions;

function normalize(s){ return s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,''); }

function buildDots(){
  const d = document.getElementById('dots'); d.innerHTML = '';
  activeQuestions.forEach(function(_, i){
    const dot = document.createElement('div');
    dot.className = 'dot' + (i===current?' active': i<current?' done':'');
    d.appendChild(dot);
  });
}
function buildLives(){
  const l = document.getElementById('lives-bar'); l.innerHTML = '';
  for(var i=0;i<3;i++){
    const h = document.createElement('span');
    h.style.fontSize = '15px';
    h.textContent = i<lives ? '❤️' : '🖤';
    l.appendChild(h);
  }
}

function setMode(mode){
  phase = mode;
  const wrap = document.getElementById('quiz-wrap');
  wrap.className = 'mode-' + (mode === 'dad' ? 'dad' : 'flirt');
}

function showQuestion(){
  answered = false;
  const q = activeQuestions[current];
  const label = phase === 'flirt' ? 'FLIRT Q ' : 'QUESTION ';
  document.getElementById('q-num').textContent = label + (current+1) + ' / ' + activeQuestions.length;

  const wrap = document.getElementById('sentence-wrap');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  q.parts.forEach(function(part, i){
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.textContent = part;
    wrap.appendChild(span);
    if(i < q.answers.length){
      const inp = document.createElement('input');
      inp.type = 'text';
      inp.className = 'blank-input';
      inp.id = 'blank-' + i;
      inp.autocomplete = 'off';
      inp.spellcheck = false;
      const len = q.answers[i].length;
      inp.style.width = Math.max(90, len*13+30) + 'px';
      inp.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter') checkAnswer(); });
      inp.addEventListener('input', function(){
        inp.style.width = Math.max(90, inp.value.length*13+30) + 'px';
      });
      wrap.appendChild(inp);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('submit-btn').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('feedback').className = 'feedback';
  document.getElementById('feedback').innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('next-btn').className = 'next-btn';
  buildDots(); buildLives();
  document.getElementById('score-val').textContent = score;
  setTimeout(function(){ var b=document.getElementById('blank-0'); if(b) b.focus(); }, 80);
}

function checkAnswer(){
  if(answered) return;
  const q = activeQuestions[current];
  let allCorrect = true;
  const inputs = [];
  for(var i=0; i<q.answers.length; i++){
    const inp = document.getElementById('blank-'+i);
    inputs.push(inp);
    if(normalize(inp.value) !== normalize(q.answers[i])) allCorrect = false;
  }
  if(inputs.every(function(inp){ return inp.value.trim()===''; })){ inputs[0].focus(); return; }

  answered = true;
  document.getElementById('submit-btn').disabled = true;
  inputs.forEach(function(inp){ inp.disabled = true; });

  const fb = document.getElementById('feedback');
  const isFlirt = phase === 'flirt';

  if(allCorrect){
    score++;
    document.getElementById('score-val').textContent = score;
    inputs.forEach(function(inp){ inp.className = 'blank-input correct-input'; });
    fb.className = 'feedback ' + (isFlirt ? 'ok-flirt' : 'ok') + ' show';
    fb.innerHTML = '<img class="cat-img" src="'+HAPPY_CAT+'" alt="happy"/><span>' + (isFlirt?'💕':'✅') + ' ' + q.win + '</span>';
  } else {
    lives--;
    buildLives();
    inputs.forEach(function(inp, i){
      inp.className = 'blank-input ' + (normalize(inp.value)===normalize(q.answers[i]) ? 'correct-input' : 'wrong-input');
    });
    fb.className = 'feedback fail show';
    fb.innerHTML = '<img class="cat-img" src="'+SAD_CAT+'" alt="sad"/><div><div>❌ '+q.lose+'</div><div class="reveal-ans">Answer: <b>'+q.answers.join(' / ')+'</b></div></div>';
    if(lives<=0){ setTimeout(showLose,1400); return; }
  }

  const nb = document.getElementById('next-btn');
  nb.className = 'next-btn show';
  const isLast = current === activeQuestions.length - 1;
  if(isLast && phase === 'dad') nb.textContent = 'NEXT ROUND 💕';
  else if(isLast && phase === 'flirt') nb.textContent = 'SEE RESULT >';
  else nb.textContent = 'NEXT >';
}

document.getElementById('submit-btn').onclick = checkAnswer;
document.getElementById('next-btn').onclick = function(){
  const isLast = current === activeQuestions.length - 1;
  if(isLast && phase === 'dad'){
    // show flirt transition banner
    document.getElementById('q-card').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('flirt-banner').className = 'section-banner show';
  } else if(isLast && phase === 'flirt'){
    showWin();
  } else {
    current++;
    showQuestion();
  }
};

function startFlirtRound(){
  document.getElementById('flirt-banner').className = 'section-banner';
  document.getElementById('q-card').style.display = '';
  setMode('flirt');
  activeQuestions = flirtQuestions;
  current = 0;
  showQuestion();
  // spawn hearts
  spawnHearts();
}

function revealPrize(){
  document.getElementById('scratch-overlay').classList.add('gone');
  document.getElementById('prize-hint').textContent = '🌟 There you go! 🌟';
}
function showWin(){
  document.getElementById('q-card').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('win-card').className = 'win-card show';
  if(phase === 'flirt'){
    document.getElementById('win-msg').innerHTML = 'Smooth talker! You nailed it 😏<br>Here\'s your well-earned prize 💕';
  }
  spawnStars();
}
function showLose(){
  document.getElementById('q-card').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('lose-score').textContent = score;
  document.getElementById('lose-card').className = 'lose-card show';
}
function spawnStars(){
  const sr = document.getElementById('stars'); sr.innerHTML = '';
  const emojis = phase==='flirt' ? ['💕','💘','💖','✨','🌟','😍'] : ['⭐','🌟','💫','🪙','🍄','🎉'];
  for(var i=0;i<22;i++){
    const s = document.createElement('div'); s.className = 'star';
    s.textContent = emojis[Math.floor(Math.random()*emojis.length)];
    s.style.left = Math.random()*100+'%';
    s.style.fontSize = (12+Math.random()*14)+'px';
    s.style.animationDuration = (1.3+Math.random()*2)+'s';
    s.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*2.5)+'s';
    sr.appendChild(s);
  }
}
function spawnHearts(){
  // floating hearts when transitioning to flirt round
  const wrap = document.getElementById('quiz-wrap');
  const rain = document.createElement('div');
  rain.className = 'heart-rain';
  wrap.appendChild(rain);
  const hearts = ['💕','💘','💖','💝','😍'];
  for(var i=0;i<15;i++){
    const h = document.createElement('div'); h.className = 'heart-p';
    h.textContent = hearts[Math.floor(Math.random()*hearts.length)];
    h.style.left = Math.random()*100+'%';
    h.style.animationDuration = (1.5+Math.random()*2)+'s';
    h.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*1.5)+'s';
    rain.appendChild(h);
  }
  setTimeout(function(){ wrap.removeChild(rain); }, 4000);
}
function restartGame(){
  current = 0; score = 0; lives = 3; answered = false;
  phase = 'dad'; activeQuestions = dadQuestions;
  setMode('dad');
  document.getElementById('q-card').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('win-card').className = 'win-card';
  document.getElementById('lose-card').className = 'lose-card';
  document.getElementById('flirt-banner').className = 'section-banner';
  document.getElementById('scratch-overlay').classList.remove('gone');
  document.getElementById('prize-hint').textContent = '👆 TAP TO SCRATCH!';
  showQuestion();
}
showQuestion();
</script>
</body>
</html>
